reason: Exploration slot: spec E-20260926-09 is a cheap test (S, about 0.9M tokens) of whether decision records with a pre-change reason make the staleness audit more precise than bare facts, run alongside H10a's source-change control. No current belief covers record representation, so a pass could seed a new lead belief and would inform whether P5's reason field becomes mandatory. The card's evidence is opinion only, which is why the result is directional.
